prompt:
Paint ONE building for a top-down pixel-art JRPG town map, in the classic 3/4 top-down RPG view: the roof is seen from above (it fills the upper coloured block of the guide) and the front wall is seen straight on (the lower block). The attached image is an exact layout guide drawn at the final proportions: keep the outer silhouette, the roof/wall split line, the door (dark brown rectangle: it must stay exactly there, same size, at ground level, a real door you can walk through) and the windows (yellow rectangles) in exactly the same places. You may add small details (eaves, trim, drainpipe, flower boxes, crates by the wall, a chimney poking above the roof into the empty top margin).
This building: a small house in a snow-buried northern village. Snow-covered steep roof. Dark log walls with snow drifts against them, small warm windows. Windows glow warm amber from inside (the only light). The whole image is 176 x 160 art pixels (each art pixel 7x7 image pixels).
Premium modern hi-bit 2D pixel art ("HD pixel art" JRPG look), hand-placed pixels. Every art pixel is a crisp square of the same size across the whole image (about 8x8 image pixels per art pixel). No anti-aliasing, no blur, no soft brushes, no photographic texture, no noise, no dithering checkerboards. Clusters of 3-10 pixels with clear shapes. Hue-shifted colour ramps: shadows lean toward purple/red and are more saturated, highlights lean toward warm yellow. 4-6 shades per material, rich but earthy, worn and lived-in.
Lighting: neutral, soft, even light from the upper left, like a calm overcast evening; NO cast shadows, NO night darkness, NO lamp light pools, NO vignette. (The game engine adds the night lighting on top later, so this must be the clean base colours.)
Background: fully transparent (the magenta in the guide is background). No ground, no shadow, no people, no text, no letters.

The attached guide is authoritative for geometry and placement, not merely inspiration: maintain the rectangular outer roof silhouette from x=14 to 1219, y=196 to 715 on its 1232x1120 guide, with horizontal roof/eave split around y=423-437; front wall x=56 to1176 y=715 to1120; left window x=238-350 y=896-1037, right x=868-981 y=896-1037; dark brown usable front door x=539-693 y=896-1120, opening exactly at the bottom edge. Output same aspect ratio, exactly 176x160 ART PIXELS in design (reference shown scaled 7x): preserve all relative coordinates. Roof upper region seen from above in classic top-down 3/4 JRPG sprite, front facade seen straight on; do not turn into an isometric perspective or triangular gable. Render roof with thick windswept white and blue snow in hard-edged clean clustered pixels, subtle visible steep roof structure beneath, icy blue and violet shadow creases, snowy drip at eaves without changing the roof-wall division. Wall dark horizontally laid timber logs with restrained warm worn edges, snow drift adhered at bottom and side edges without covering or relocating the door or windows. Both windows same rectangular position and dimensions as guide, vivid amber warm panes, deep wooden frames; amber inside windows is only light. Dark brown doorway exact position and width, real tall unobstructed walk-through door touching bottom image boundary. Optional tiny chimney in empty top margin and modest snow lumps. Fully transparent background replacing all magenta, absolutely no ground or drop shadow, no typography. Crisp uniformly square pixel-grid, lovingly hand-placed premium modern HD 2D pixel art JRPG sprite, clean clear 3–10 art pixel color clusters, 4-6 deliberate hue-shifted shades per material, earthy rich shades, saturated plum/burgundy shadows and warm cream highlights. Neutral even soft upper-left overcast illumination, clean bright readable base colors, no night tint, no cast shadows, no glow halos, no soft focus, no anti alias, no dithering or noise. The composition should fill exactly the same area as reference.
